metaTitle: Custom Sublimation T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation t shirts with full-color all-over prints. Perfect for events and teams. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Sublimation printing creates vibrant, full-color designs that fuse directly into polyester fabric, meaning your artwork won't crack, peel, or fade. For corporate events, trade shows, or team uniforms, custom sublimation t shirts deliver photo-quality graphics edge to edge. Choose moisture-wicking performance tees or soft polyesters blends, and let your logo or artwork wrap around the entire shirt for maximum brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation t shirts with full-color all-over print on performance fabric
